hls.js (v1.6.13)
=================
Project: https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js
License: Apache 2.0; see LICENSE.

This file is the upstream UMD distributable and is not maintained here.
On Moodle pages, RequireJS loads the bundle as an AMD module. Do not inject
this bundle through a script element: when define.amd is present, the library
exports via define() rather than assigning window.Hls.

Source maps are not distributed with this release artifact.
